Amyloid-beta Sex
```{r}
Ab_sex_df <-data.frame(
  group = c('Female_High', 'Female_Normal', 'Male_High', 'Male_Normal'),
  value = c(19, 31, 16, 24)
)

Ab_sex_df$percentage <- round(100 * Ab_sex_df$value / sum(Ab_sex_df$value), 1)

# Create the donut chart
plot1<- ggplot(Ab_sex_df, aes(x = 2, y = value, fill = group)) + 
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", width = 1) +
  coord_polar(theta = "y", start = pi/2) +  # Polar coordinates for the donut
  xlim(0.5, 2.5) +  # Adjust limits to show half donut
  geom_text(aes(label = paste0(value, "(", percentage,"%)")), position = position_stack(vjust = 0.5), size = 3) +  # Add labels
  theme_void() + 
  theme(legend.position = "top", 
        legend.text = element_text(size = 8), 
        legend.title = element_text(size = 8),) + 
  scale_fill_manual(values = c('#FF6666','#E89DA0','#3399FF','#C7DFF0'))
plot1
# ggsave("../plots/amyloid-beta-sex-donut.pdf", plot = plot1, width = 8, height = 6)
```

Gender PET-amyloid
```{r}
library(readxl)
library(dplyr)
check_centiloid = read_excel('../data/raw_data/check.xlsx', sheet ='Centiloid')
check_centiloid <- check_centiloid %>% mutate(Gender = recode(Gender, "F" = "Female", "M" = "Male"))
sex_suvr_df <-data.frame(
  group = check_centiloid$Gender,
  score = check_centiloid$Image.PET.Centiloid
)


plot2<-ggplot(sex_suvr_df, aes(x = score, fill = group)) + 
  geom_density(alpha = 0.5) + 
  geom_vline(xintercept = 15, linetype = "dashed", color = "black") +  # Vertical line at x = 15
  annotate("text", x = 10, y = 0.025, label = "Amyloid-beta Normal", size = 2.5, hjust = 1) +  # Label on the left
  annotate("text", x = 75, y = 0.025, label = "Amyloid-beta High", size = 2.5, hjust = 0) +  # Label on the right
  scale_x_continuous(limits = c(-25, 140)) +  
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 0.04)) +  
  labs(x = "PET Centiloid Value", y = "Distribution frequency (%)") + 
  geom_jitter(aes(y = 0, color = group), width = 0.2, height = 0, alpha = 0.5, size = 2) +  # Add scatter dots with color for each group
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("Female" = "#FF9999", "Male" = "#66B3FF")) +  # Custom fill colors for Female and Male
  scale_color_manual(values = c("Female" = "#FF6666", "Male" = "#3399FF")) +  # Custom colors for scatter dots
  theme_minimal() + 
  theme(legend.position = "top", 
        legend.text = element_text(size = 8), 
        legend.title = element_text(size = 8),
        panel.grid = element_blank()) 

plot2
```

```{r}
APOE_df <- data.frame(
  category = c(rep("Female", 4), rep("Male", 4)),
  value = c(7, 28, 2, 13, 4, 20, 14, 2),
  group = c("E3/E2", "E3/E3", "E4/E2", "E4/E3", "E3/E2", "E3/E3", "E4/E3", "E4/E4")
)


plot3<- ggplot(APOE_df, aes(x = category, y = value, fill = group)) + 
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", position = "stack") + 
  geom_text(aes(label = value), position = position_stack(vjust = 0.5), color = "white", size = 3) +  
  coord_flip() + 
  labs(x = " ", y = "Count") + 
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("#C9DCC4", "#AEB2D1", "#92A5D1", "#D989D4", "#E89DA0")) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 15) +  
  theme(panel.grid = element_blank(),  
        panel.background = element_rect(fill = "white"),  
        legend.position = "top",  
        legend.text = element_text(size = 8),  
        legend.title = element_text(size = 8),
        axis.title.x = element_text(size = 10), 
        axis.title.y = element_text(size = 10),
        axis.text.x = element_text(size = 10),  
        axis.text.y = element_text(size = 10))  
plot3
```
```{r}
age_sex_df <- basic_statis_info_df[, c('Demographic.Sex', 'Age')]
age_sex_df <- age_sex_df %>%
  mutate(age_group = cut(Age, breaks = c(60, 65, 70, 75, 80, 85, 90), labels = c('60-64','65-69','70-74', '75-79', '80-84', '85-90'), right = FALSE))

# Summarize population by age group and gender
population_summary <- age_sex_df %>%
  group_by(age_group, Demographic.Sex) %>%
  summarise(Population = n(), .groups = 'drop')
population_pyramid_df <- population_summary %>%
  mutate(Population = ifelse(Demographic.Sex == "Female", -Population, Population))
population_pyramid_df <- population_pyramid_df %>%
  rename(Age = age_group, Gender = Demographic.Sex)


plot4<-ggplot(population_pyramid_df, aes(x = Age, y = Population, fill = Gender)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity") +
  coord_flip() +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = abs) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("Male" = "#3399FF", "Female" = "#FF6666")) +
  labs(x = "Age Group", y = "Population (%)", title = " ") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(panel.grid = element_blank(),  
        legend.text = element_text(size = 8), 
        legend.title = element_text(size = 8),
        axis.title.x = element_text(size = 10),  
        axis.title.y = element_text(size = 10),
        axis.text.x = element_text(size = 10),  
        axis.text.y = element_text(size = 10),
        panel.background = element_rect(fill = "white"),
        legend.position = "top")

plot4
```


```{r}
#install.packages("gridExtra")
library(grid)
library(gridExtra)
library(ggplot2)

plot1_labeled <- arrangeGrob(plot1, top = textGrob("A", x = unit(0.02, "npc"), y = unit(0.98, "npc"), just = c("left", "top"), gp = gpar(fontsize = 15, fontface = "bold")))
plot2_labeled <- arrangeGrob(plot2, top = textGrob("B", x = unit(0.02, "npc"), y = unit(0.98, "npc"), just = c("left", "top"), gp = gpar(fontsize = 15, fontface = "bold")))
plot3_labeled <- arrangeGrob(plot3, top = textGrob("C", x = unit(0.02, "npc"), y = unit(0.98, "npc"), just = c("left", "top"), gp = gpar(fontsize = 15, fontface = "bold")))
plot4_labeled <- arrangeGrob(plot4, top = textGrob("D", x = unit(0.02, "npc"), y = unit(0.98, "npc"), just = c("left", "top"), gp = gpar(fontsize = 15, fontface = "bold")))

pdf("../plots/combined_plots_gridextra_labeled.pdf", width = 10, height = 8)
grid.arrange(plot1_labeled, plot2_labeled, plot3_labeled, plot4_labeled, ncol = 2, nrow = 2)
dev.off()
```
